title: Coin of the Realm
description: Money night on Snazzie FM. Chad has invented the next big cryptocurrency. It is backed, he insists, by real pigeons.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on Snazzie FM, and the Truth Hour rolls on. Tonight, we talk money. Specifically, money that doesn't exist yet.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's just called debt, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It's called opportunity, Barry. Our first caller is a young entrepreneur. Chad, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yo, Ronnie, what's good. Okay, listen. <p:0.3> I've got the next big one. It's called PigeonCoin.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...Pigeon. Coin.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: PigeonCoin, bro. It's backed by real pigeons. You can't fake a pigeon.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that is the kind of security the banks do not want you to have.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Exactly, Ronnie! Every coin is tied to one actual pigeon. When the pigeon flies, the value goes up.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What happens when the pigeon lands, Chad?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: ...You don't let it land, Barry. <p:0.3> That's the whole strategy.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Fascinating. So the value is, in a sense, up in the air.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Always up in the air, Ronnie. That's the beauty of it.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: And who is holding all these pigeons?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Me, Barry. I've got like four hundred pigeons in my garage. It's a vault, basically.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A living vault.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's a health code violation, is what that is.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's a decentralized aviary, Barry. Do your research.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now Chad, walk me through the technology. How does a pigeon actually become a coin?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Okay, so each pigeon has a little tag on its leg, right? <p:0.3> The tag has a number. That number is the coin. Boom. Blockchain.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's just a leg band, Chad. Pigeon racers have done that for a hundred years.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: And nobody monetized it, Barry! That's the gap in the market.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: He found the gap, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The gap is fraud, Ronnie. The gap is just fraud.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's not fraud if the pigeon consents.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: ...How does a pigeon consent, Chad?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It stays, Barry. <p:0.4> If it didn't consent, it would fly off. The ones that stay? Those are investors.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: The pigeons are shareholders. I love this.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> Sorry to cut in, the phone lines are kind of... melting?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Melting how, Todd?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Like four hundred people are calling, and they all say they own a pigeon. <p:0.3> And one guy is just... cooing.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: That's the community, Todd! That's the PigeonCoin army!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Yeah, I got a question for the kid. <p:0.4> How do I sell my PigeonCoin?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: ...You don't sell, Gary. You hold. Forever.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: So it's worthless.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's priceless, Gary. There's a difference.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Chad, what's the coin actually worth right now? In real dollars.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Dollars are a fiat illusion, Barry. <p:0.3> But if you're asking, one coin is worth one pigeon.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And what is a pigeon worth?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: ...One coin, Ronnie. It's a closed loop. Totally stable.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: That's circular, Chad. That means it's worth nothing.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It means it can never crash, Barry. <p:0.3> It's pinned to itself.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Self pinned. The dream of every currency.

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Ronnie, the cooing guy is still on line two. <p:0.3> He will not stop cooing.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Put him through right after the break. The people want to hear the coo.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Please do not put the cooing man on the radio, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: The coo is bullish, Barry. <p:0.3> Cooing means accumulation.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Accumulation. Write that down, folks.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And on that note of financial wisdom, we'll take a quick break. PigeonCoin. <p:0.3> To the moon, or at least to the roof.
